name: get_day_calendar_events
description: Returns the appointments for the given `day`. Returns a list of dictionaries with informations about each meeting. Returns the IDENTIFIERS held here (an index), not the records — the region is far too large to return at once. Take the id you need and fetch that single record with this region's per-record getter.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: The day for which to return the appointments. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD.
